title: feat: Cloudron package for Warmbly 0.6.70 with store media
body:
## Summary

First Cloudron package for [Warmbly](https://github.com/warmbly/warmbly) v0.6.70 (upstream commit `63f10ef2d6865469640799309deba39150f140b1`, Apache-2.0), with the README, banner and Cloudron Community Apps store media.

- **Package:** one container running upstream's API, consumer, worker, tracking, forms, realtime gateway and NATS under supervisord, on Cloudron PostgreSQL and Redis; four secondary domains (API, admin, tracking, forms); platform mail through the `sendmail` addon. Upstream release images pinned by digest; the realtime gateway is rebuilt from the same commit.
- **Cloudron sign-in:** `oidc` addon. `patches/0001-cloudron-oidc-first-user-owner.patch` makes the first Cloudron sign-in on an unclaimed instance its owner and platform admin, only while no account holds admin (`WARMBLY_OIDC_FIRST_USER_OWNER=false` restores upstream's setup link).
- **Sign-in screen:** upstream shows its SSO button only after an email is typed, then ignores that email. `web-extra/cloudron-sso.js` (injected by nginx) adds "Continue with <Cloudron name>" to the first screen with a note that no email or password is needed, and that the first sign-in claims a new instance. It starts upstream's own OIDC flow; if the upstream form isn't found it does nothing.
- **Store and README media:** `logo.png` (256×256), five 2400×800 listing slides, and a 1280×640 README banner, rendered from `media/src/*.html` by `scripts/render-store-media.sh` from upstream screenshots. Provenance (upstream paths, blob-identical at the pinned commit) is in `DESIGN.md`.
- **Publishing:** empty `CloudronVersions.json`, the managed catalog workflow (aidevops pin `6606b999`) with package checks (ShellCheck, `node --check`, patch apply against the pinned commit), and `docs/PUBLISHING.md`.

Two commits: the first adds everything; the second pins `iconUrl` and `mediaLinks` to the first. **Merge with a merge commit, not a squash,** so the pinned commit stays reachable from `main`.

## Verification

- Installed from source on a test Cloudron (`cloudron update` from this tree): app healthy; `/healthz` and API `/health` return 200.
- First-owner sign-in confirmed by the maintainer with a Cloudron account.
- Live sign-in screen (headless Chromium): "Continue with <Cloudron name>" and the no-email note render on the first screen; `POST /v1/auth/oidc/begin` returns a provider URL on the Cloudron and a binding.
- `shellcheck -x start.sh bin/warmblyctl bin/wait-for scripts/render-store-media.sh`: clean. `node --check web-extra/cloudron-sso.js`: clean.
- Catalog dry run with Cloudron CLI 9.0.3 in a scratch copy: `versions add --state testing`, `versions update --state=published`, `versions verify` → valid; changelog, icon and 5 media links present.
- `iconUrl` and all `mediaLinks`: HTTPS 200, `image/png`.

## Not in this PR

- Publication: requires `CLOUDRON_PUBLICATION_ENABLED=true`, the `CLOUDRON_RELEASE_PAT` repository secret, and a public GHCR package after the first push (see `docs/PUBLISHING.md`). The Community Apps listing and forum announcement follow a published version.
- Upstream v0.6.71 was released today; this pins the tested v0.6.70. Moving the pin is a follow-up release.
- Known limit (README *Limits*): `/v1/auth/config` reports the gateway's internal `websocket_url`, because the API uses the same setting to proxy the dashboard's socket. Upstream's CLI event stream and SDK socket discovery don't work on this package; the dashboard is unaffected.

<!-- aidevops:origin:interactive -->
<!-- aidevops:sig -->
---

title: chore: update Warmbly to v0.6.72 (GH#9)
body:
## Summary
- Resolves #9: prepare Cloudron package 0.1.4 for Warmbly v0.6.72.
- CloudronManifest.json updates package/upstream versions and the release-pinned license URL. Dockerfile pins release commit 8ce7c0c3225ac44bfa02afda95ed3ef119c0349c and all seven release image digests from upstream images.json. CHANGELOG records the update.
- Follow docs/PUBLISHING.md and the existing pinned-release pattern. The Cloudron base, addons, runtime configuration and first-owner patch are unchanged.

## Verification
- cloudron-package-helper.sh preflight-release v0.1.4: passed.
- cloudron-package-helper.sh validate and check-compatibility: passed.
- shellcheck -x start.sh bin/warmblyctl bin/wait-for scripts/render-store-media.sh: passed.
- node --check web-extra/cloudron-sso.js: passed.
- cloudron versions verify (CLI 9.0.4): passed, existing four-version catalog unchanged.
- git apply --check of patches/0001-cloudron-oidc-first-user-owner.patch against exact upstream release commit: passed. Image build also applied the patch and compiled the backend successfully.
- docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --load --tag cloudron-warmbly-issue9:0.1.4 --progress plain .: passed without push; local image sha256:1caae811c097340ee1bcfe1137719996e9a510cadd026cae8fb09e6740bd4c98.
- git diff --check: passed. Direct self-review confirms only the three declared files changed and every release pin matches upstream metadata.

## Runtime Testing
- Read-only local amd64 container: upstream version/commit markers match; NATS starts its version command; warmblyctl help executes; realtime release evaluates crypto.strong_rand_bytes successfully using non-secret smoke-test configuration.
- Upstream sign-in page and auth client sources are unchanged between v0.6.70 and v0.6.72; the email input retains autocomplete=username webauthn, matching the package selector.
- Live Cloudron install, SSO, mail delivery and backup/restore qualification were not performed. No deployment is authorized by this task.

## Existing upstream warning
- Hex reports cowlib 2.21.0 advisory EEF-CVE-2026-43966 / CVE-2026-43966 during the successful realtime build. realtime/mix.lock is byte-for-byte unchanged from v0.6.70; this pre-existing upstream dependency is not modified in this package update. No unrelated dependency repair is included.

## Release boundary
- Do not merge. Signed maintainer approval is required through cloudron-release-approval-helper.sh request before merge/publication.
- No image push, tag, catalog mutation, release publication or deployment was performed.

title: chore: resync framework workflow to aidevops canonical caller
body:
## Summary

Resync `.github/workflows/issue-triage-gate.yml` to the canonical aidevops caller template
(reusable-workflow pattern, GH#20649 + GH#20727).

**Classification before**: `NO-WORKFLOW`
**Ref**: `@main`

## Why

The aidevops framework ships managed GitHub Actions workflows as reusable
workflows. Downstream repos carry ~45-line callers that delegate all logic
to the configured aidevops reusable workflow repository/ref.

This PR brings this repo in line with the canonical template, eliminating
drift and unblocking automatic updates when the framework evolves.

## How to verify

After merge, trigger an event matching the workflow triggers. Framework
scripts are fetched at runtime via a secondary checkout — no
`.agents/scripts/` files are needed in this repo.

## Rollback

If the workflow breaks, revert this PR. The previous workflow is preserved
in git history at the parent commit.

Generated by: `aidevops sync-workflows --apply` (see marcusquinn/aidevops#20649).

title: GH#21: chore: update Warmbly to v0.7.2
body:
## Summary

Bump the package to 0.1.7 and upstream Warmbly to v0.7.2 (commit 7af95ad). Issue #21 reported v0.7.1; v0.7.2 was released afterwards (2026-11-08) and is packaged instead so one release covers both. Release image digests come from upstream's v0.7.2 images.json. Upstream changed no Dockerfiles, nginx configs or image layouts between v0.6.78 and v0.7.2, and all new settings (lead finder, Cloudflare for SaaS, BOX_GOOGLE_APP_NAME) are optional. The dashboard renderer no longer reads WARMBLY_GMAIL_OAUTH_CONNECT (upstream #1184), so start.sh stops computing and passing it; the backend still honours BOX_GOOGLE_OAUTH_CONNECT. The CHANGELOG tells operators with their own Google OAuth client that Gmail now requests the https://mail.google.com/ scope.



## Files Changed

CHANGELOG, CloudronManifest.json, Dockerfile, start.sh

## Decisions

Packaged v0.7.2 rather than the reported v0.7.1 to avoid a second release cycle for a release that already superseded it. Package version follows the existing patch-bump pattern (0.1.7).

## Runtime Testing

- **Risk level:** Medium
- **Verification:** self-assessed — git apply --check of patches/0001 against v0.7.2 (applies with offsets); docker build of the full image succeeded locally (patched backend compiled, realtime release built), image reports v0.7.2/7af95ad, patched backend starts and reaches config loading; web-config.sh has no GMAIL_OAUTH reference and the CSP template includes the lead finder tile origin; web-extra/cloudron-sso.js selectors (email input with autocomplete webauthn, sso_binding, /v1/auth/oidc/begin) still match upstream v0.7.2; shellcheck -x on start.sh, bin/*, scripts/*.sh clean; node --check web-extra/cloudron-sso.js; cloudron-package-helper.sh preflight-release v0.1.7 passed. Risk: medium (package config); not yet qualified on a live Cloudron test install.

Resolves #21
